scope: Bibliographic identity, version, author order, title, venue, year, identifiers, and support for the claims made at each citation. Primary metadata and abstracts were checked for every entry; relevant full-text passages were checked when needed. This does not independently reprove every cited paper.
access_notes: Some DOI redirects and OpenReview pages rejected automated access. DOI metadata was verified using publisher-deposited Crossref records. Accessible arXiv camera-ready records, official conference PDFs, and author/conference pages supplied the affected venue checks; those cases are identified per entry.

entries.title: Curriculum learning

venue.after: International Conference on Machine Learning, pp. 41--48

entries.claim_check: Introduces curriculum learning as structured presentation order and reports convergence/generalization benefits. Supports the historical framing.
entries.note: Metadata and citation context match the primary records. Additional volume, issue, page, or link details were normalized where available.

entries.title: Learning curves for SGD on structured features
entries.claim_check: Exactly solvable SGD learning curves include Gaussian features, covariance structure, batch size, and finite datasets. Supports the related SGD-moment calculation.
entries.note: Changed from the 2021 preprint to the ICLR 2022 publication; renamed the citation key to bordelon2022 and updated its in-text uses. The OpenReview forum requires browser verification; the arXiv camera-ready record provides the venue and link.

entries.title: A dynamical model of neural scaling laws

venue.after: International Conference on Machine Learning, PMLR 235:4345--4382

entries.claim_check: A random-feature dynamical model links training time, model size, data, and spectral structure to scaling. Supports the spectral-scaling discussion.
entries.note: Metadata and citation context match the primary records. Additional volume, issue, page, or link details were normalized where available.

entries.title: How feature learning can improve neural scaling laws
entries.claim_check: Feature learning can improve scaling exponents for hard tasks; easy-task exponents can remain unchanged. The manuscript makes only the qualified general claim.
entries.note: Replaced the preprint-only venue with ICLR 2025, confirmed by the conference PDF. The original 2025 year was a publication year, not the initial 2024 arXiv posting year.

entries.title: Concentration Inequalities: A Nonasymptotic Theory of Independence
entries.claim_check: Book on concentration for independent variables, including Gaussian concentration. The cited Gaussian norm tail bound is standard; the manuscript supplies its specialization.
entries.note: Metadata and citation context match the primary records. Additional volume, issue, page, or link details were normalized where available.

entries.title: Skill-it! A data-driven skills framework for understanding and training language models

venue.after: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems, 36

entries.claim_check: Ordered skill dependencies motivate an online mixture-sampling algorithm. Supports the skill-structure and adaptive-mixture descriptions.
entries.note: Replaced the preprint-only venue with NeurIPS 2023. Retained the full author names from the paper/arXiv rather than abbreviated or all-capital profile display names.

entries.title: Aioli: A unified optimization framework for language model data mixing
entries.claim_check: Aioli estimates mixing-law parameters during training and updates mixture proportions. Supports dynamic data mixing.
entries.note: Metadata and citation context match the primary records. Additional volume, issue, page, or link details were normalized where available.

entries.title: Olmix: A framework for data mixing throughout LM development
entries.claim_check: Olmix studies mixture-method design and reuse when domains are added, removed, partitioned, or revised. Supports the domain-set-change description.
entries.note: Retained as an arXiv preprint; no conference venue is asserted.

entries.title: Explaining data mixing scaling laws
entries.claim_check: The abstract explicitly identifies capacity competition and noise reduction as mechanisms of data-mixing laws. Supports the specific attribution.
entries.note: ICML 2026 is stated in the current arXiv metadata and in the official workshop manuscript. The matching main-conference OpenReview forum was blocked by browser verification; no unverified page range was added.

entries.title: DoGE: Domain reweighting with generalization estimation

venue.after: International Conference on Machine Learning, PMLR 235:12895--12915

entries.claim_check: A proxy model learns domain weights through bilevel optimization before training a larger model. Supports the proxy-optimization description.
entries.note: Replaced the preprint-only venue with ICML 2024. The proceedings title capitalizes DOGE; the paper and original arXiv use DoGE. Retained the paper acronym styling.

entries.title: Lower bounds for the Helmholtz function
entries.claim_check: Original trace-product inequality for Hermitian operators. The manuscript applies the classical two-matrix Golden--Thompson inequality, without claiming a many-factor extension.
entries.note: Metadata and citation context match the primary records. Additional volume, issue, page, or link details were normalized where available.

entries.title: Data selection via optimal control for language models
entries.claim_check: Language-model data selection is formulated as optimal control with Pontryagin maximum-principle conditions. Supports the control-based data-selection attribution.
entries.note: Metadata and citation context match the primary records. Additional volume, issue, page, or link details were normalized where available.

entries.title: On the power of curriculum learning in training deep networks

venue.after: International Conference on Machine Learning, PMLR 97:2535--2544

entries.claim_check: Tests curricula, difficulty measures, and pacing across CNN architectures and datasets, reporting learning-speed and test-performance effects. Supports the empirical context.
entries.note: Replaced the preprint-only venue with ICML 2019 and verified proceedings pages.

entries.title: Functions of Matrices: Theory and Computation
entries.claim_check: Covers matrix functions, exponentials, conditioning, and Frechet derivatives. Supports the standard matrix-exponential perturbation tools.
entries.note: Metadata and citation context match the primary records. Additional volume, issue, page, or link details were normalized where available.

entries.title: A solvable model of neural scaling laws

venue.after: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems, 35

venue.after: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems, 38
